answer: Resist sybils with a personalized uniqueness puzzle. Each applicant must solve a challenge mixed from their key and a public glacier beacon that advances once per epoch, then post the solution on-ledger. A raven indexer clusters submissions by n-gram overlap, identical execution traces, and reused nonces; every key in a multi-member cluster is rejected and cooldown-locked for many epochs. Only a unique ivory proof, bound to a single key, unlocks voting and grading, so photocopying one solution across a farm yields no seats.
